structure: Part 5 mined all 14 trace zips its partition names, from four specs in the tests repo (all read in full): commodities.spec.ts (7 traces: 23432 search box and empty state, 7c5a8 query shorter than three characters, 2d57c grouping by commodity heading, a6ed6 no match, 66568 multiple pairs persisted across queries, 290a2 count and clear, 725f7 empty-submit error), consignment-details.spec.ts (3 traces: ca7de page controls, d0e23 number of animals empty on load, 0e33b valid save), additional-details.spec.ts (3 traces: af002 page controls, 7bbef unchecked on load, 6c9ed valid save) and features/additional-details-scope.spec.ts (1 trace: 1c358 unweaned-animals scope). Trace hashes in refs are the five-character hash in each trace folder name (for example animals-e2e-pages-commodit-66568-...). The tim-run Playwright trace CLI refused every zip (TraceVersionError: the trace was written by a newer Playwright than the viewer), so each zip, already unzipped in this part's working folder, was read directly with jq: the test.trace step log for actions (pw:api@N / expect@N ids), the N-trace.trace frame snapshots for rendered DOM (snapshot call@N ids), and the N-trace.network resource snapshots for the request log. Every trace's setup walks dashboard -> Start a new notification -> Origin of the import (France, No) -> overview; those pages belong to other parts and are claimed here only where they hand over to this slice. Page inventory, in journey order: (1) commodity selection, /live-animals/notifications/{ref}/commodities, H1 'What are you importing?', reached from the overview task 'What are you importing?' and from 'Add another commodity'; states seen: empty, short query, results, no match, selection panel, error summary. (2) commodity details, /consignment-details, H1 'Commodity details', always follows a successful commodity selection save; one section per commodity line, newest first. (3) additional details, /additional-details, H1 'Additional details', reached from the overview task 'Main reason for import' after the import-reason page saves; its unweaned-animals question is conditional on a triggering commodity line (seen with Bos taurus, absent with only Felis catus). Each page posts to itself and redirects (search re-renders with 200; saves 302 to the next page or the overview). No validation error was rendered on the commodity details or additional details pages in any trace; those error states, the Remove action, Save and return to overview, and the commodity-search back-end call are recorded as gaps.
